episodes.synopsis: Young aristocrat Albert visits the city of Luna on the surface of the moon. He quickly falls under the spell of an enigmatic gentleman - the Count of Monte Cristo.
episodes.title: At Journey's End, We Meet

episodes.synopsis: Albert is kidnapped! Franz's frantic attempt to collect the ransom money comes up short, so he warily seeks the assistance of the Count of Monte Cristo.
episodes.title: Until the Sun Rises over the Moon

episodes.synopsis: Back in Paris, Albert's sheltered friends grow suspicious upon the arrival of the mysterious Count of Monte Cristo.
episodes.title: 5/22, Stormy

episodes.synopsis: The questions surrounding the Count multiply when Albert visits the man's lavish mansion in Champs Elysees, which is filled with complicated tricks and gold ornaments.
episodes.title: A Mother's Secrets

episodes.synopsis: During a pleasure cruise arranged by the Count, a disagreement leads to a duel between Albert and Maximilien. Albert's raw emotions allow his host to grasp even more sway over his destiny.
episodes.title: Do You Love Your Fiancee?

episodes.synopsis: The Count of Monte Cristo positions himself deeper into the lives of those around Albert after meeting a banker and his frustrated wife.
episodes.title: Her Melancholy, My Melancholy

episodes.synopsis: The lives of Albert's aristocratic friends are full of secrets - and the Count is among those prone to whispering in the ears of ladies known to be spoken for.
episodes.title: The Secret Flower Garden

episodes.synopsis: At a party thrown by the Count, the guests play a game. They search for a secret room in the villa where a curse is sealed away. Albert has already discovered one secret kept between the Count and Heloise.
episodes.title: A Night in Boulogne

episodes.synopsis: The charms of the Count are fading for some, as mysteries and suspicions multiply. The controversy surrounding the mysterious man can only grow when a hidden poisoner begins to ply their trade.
episodes.title: I Dreamed a Dark Dream

episodes.synopsis: Villefort, Danglars, and Morcerf are invited to a funeral. Albert suspects something is wrong and follows them to an old church, where the lid of the casket is about to be opened.
episodes.title: The Letter from Edmond

episodes.synopsis: Three aristocratic households are growing aware that they are caught in a conspiracy. Franz immediately suspects the Count, but Albert won't hear of it.
episodes.title: An Engagement Broken

episodes.synopsis: Albert's engagement is in jeopardy; Baron Dangler prefers his daughter to marry into wealth. Albert rushes to the opera house to find Eugenie - but the curtain may have already closed on his love.
episodes.title: Encore

episodes.synopsis: Attorney General Villefort demands the arrest of the Count of Monte Cristo, but Heloise takes steps to prevent it from happening.
episodes.title: Haidee

episodes.synopsis: After the announcement of Eugenie and Andrea's engagement leaves Albert feeling betrayed, the Count appears and invites him on a journey deep into the universe.
episodes.title: Lost Souls

episodes.synopsis: Aboard his spaceship, the Count of Monte Cristo tells Albert about an old friend who was betrayed and imprisoned. Back home, Franz is close to learning an important secret.
episodes.title: The End of Happiness, the Beginning of Truth

episodes.synopsis: Closing in on the secret of the Gankutsuou, Franz learns of a sailor named Edmond Dantes who had strange connections to many of the families in Parisian high society.
episodes.title: Scandal

episodes.synopsis: After the Count reveals a shocking truth, Albert is left shattered when Franz explains a horrible and twisted story of revenge.
episodes.title: Confession

episodes.synopsis: Mercedes enters the misty woods to meet the Count - but only a scene of violence is waiting for her.
episodes.title: The Duel

episodes.synopsis: The Count escalates his plan for revenge, launching a bitter blow at his next target, the Danglars Bank. The impact will be felt by many - including Albert.
episodes.title: Even If I Should Stop Being Me

episodes.synopsis: Being rescued from danger by Chateau-Renaud, Albert learns about Eugenie's marriage and rushes over to the Danglars' home.
episodes.title: Farewell, Euganie

episodes.synopsis: An abominable memory, consigned to the darkness of the past, has been resurrected by the hands of the Count and his plan of revenge enters its final stage.
episodes.title: The Golden Boy's True Identity

episodes.synopsis: The final target of the Count's rage returns to Earth and the bombardment of Paris begins!
episodes.title: Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Albert and Mercedes are seriously wounded as Fernand prepares for his final showdown with the Count of Monte Cristo.
episodes.title: Edmond Dantes

episodes.synopsis: Five years later, Albert returns to Paris to visit the relics of his former life and the grave of a dear friend.
episodes.title: At the Shore
